en.title: Bitcoin Wallets May Drop New Hardware Support as Security Bridge Halts
slides: Popular Bitcoin wallets could stop supporting new hardware devices soon
A critical security bridge has stopped accepting new hardware devices
BHWI published parity tests but downstream wallets still need to complete integration work
Users may need to verify wallet compatibility before purchasing new hardware devices
en.caption: A critical security bridge has stopped accepting new Bitcoin hardware devices. Popular Bitcoin wallets face potential support gaps as downstream integration work remains incomplete. Users should verify their wallet compatibility before purchasing new hardware devices.
